scenario: A generic drug sponsor's regulatory affairs scientist processes raw pharmacokinetic data from a two-period crossover bioequivalence study, computes AUC and Cmax ratios with 90% confidence intervals, and generates an FDA-style bioequivalence assessment memo to determine whether the generic formulation meets the 80–125% BE acceptance window for ANDA submission.
info_flow: clinical-data-cleaner ingests raw PK concentration-time data from the crossover study CSV and produces a cleaned SDTM-formatted dataset → ub2-csv-data-analyzer reads the cleaned data and computes AUC(0-t), Cmax, T/R geometric mean ratios, and 90% confidence intervals → reporting assembles a structured bioequivalence assessment memo citing whether the 80–125% acceptance criterion is met.
